title: High Literary vs. Everyday Register
grammar: Nominalizations governed by postpositions (után, előtt, során, révén, helyett)
goal: I can combine possessive nominalizations with postpositions ('után', 'előtt', 'során', 'révén', 'helyett').
I can replace temporal/manner clauses ('miután elolvasta...', 'miközben vizsgálta...') with compact postpositional nominalizations.
I can recognize high-register essayistic connectors.
